test_results.observation: The real worker path, correlated transaction/connection/transaction-ID probe, independent heartbeat, finalization row-lock trace, atomic derivation and internal PDF page/offset citation projection passed. The controlled HTTP question probe showed that CitationResponse drops page_start, page_end, start_offset and end_offset. Code review also found that PDF finalization checks lease ownership only at transaction entry and not at the commit boundary. The locked citation and live-fencing outcome is therefore not satisfied.
